name: codevitals
description: Performance metrics tracking for code repositories

scripts.dev: npm run server & npm run client
scripts.db:start: docker run -d --rm --name codevitals-db -p 127.0.0.1:3307:3306 -e MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD=codevitals -e MARIADB_DATABASE=codevitals mariadb:11.8
scripts.dev:functions: node scripts/dev-functions.mjs & VITE_API_URL= npm run client
scripts.build:spacefast: VITE_API_URL= npm run build --workspace=client && node scripts/build-spacefast.mjs
